title: WIRING DIAGRAM-BODY & TAIL LAMP
summary: Rear body wiring, left side, all models (sheet D7): battery (rear-compartment battery behind the seats) with 2-gauge cables through grommets, rear body harness connector, LH door ajar warning switch, rear compartment courtesy lamp, LH backing (back-up) lamp, LH tail/stop/turn lamp (outboard), LH side marker lamp and ground eyelets. Continues up to D8 and left to D5.
notes_internal: Revision 1 marker (circled 1) is on the 20 R wire at the top edge; the old wire was 20 OR (a wire spec, not a pn, so 'was' left null). Revision AUTH 25948, DR RS, CK CI.
Label 'L.H. BACING LAMP' printed as is (backing lamp).
Sheet number K258 printed at lower right.
Wiring diagram: no callout list, part numbers, torques or materials; fastening empty because nothing is fastened on this sheet.
Wire routes are not traced in the tables; only sheet-edge wire lists and wires labelled at a component are listed.
Title block: drawing 3965172, 1970 CORVETTE SERIES, L-93230, DR RT/CI, CK 4-18-69 CI, PREL/C-O D7 3-12-69.
